header.description: What: Simulated devices SD-S2c (§3.13c D-110, R-4300). The dv-drone-fly start (POWER, ARM, TAKEOFF): the drone hovers 15 m over its launch point; then the run PAUSES for 120 frames and inside the pause the trainee presses CAM DOWN (paused frame 10 - the gimbal, the station's own state) and LAND (paused frame 30 - a MODE press, queued for the first live frame). Judge: (1) the station answers in pause: its gimbal (DroneStationState.CameraPitch and its DeviceView.Pitch) is tilted down at paused frame 20; (2) LAND is QUEUED (DroneStationState.Queued = the LAND bit, the command still Fly) at paused frame 60 and becomes the command after the pause, and the drone lands where it hovered; (3) the world does not move in the pause: the drone never leaves its hover point. Fail: the pause moves the drone, the gimbal waits for time, or LAND acts before time advances. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh dv-drone-paused
